description: National Gem and Jewellery Authority - National Gem and Jewellery Authority Act No. 50 of 1993 (Amended)
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Industries under the National Gem and Jewellery Authority Act, No. 50 of 1993. It specifically amends the Gem and Jewellery (License fee) Regulations by providing a detailed schedule of fees for various licenses and activities related to gem mining, auctioning, cutting, and transportation. This content falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes as it involves regulatory frameworks, compliance requirements, and statutory instruments related to the gem and jewellery industry.
